summary: Unconditional init of a six-dword collision material coefficients block: sets dword_7CD0C8 to 80 (material count/identifier), zeroes dword_7CD0CC through dword_7CD0D8, sets dword_7CD0DC to 18000 (range threshold literal), and returns 0. No calls and no guards.

operations.description: Return 0 (no calls, no guards; all writes unconditional).

unresolved: Semantic role of the literal 80 and the meaning of the 18000 threshold are not established; the existing analysis labels dword_7CD0C8 material count and dword_7CD0DC range threshold (DERIVED) with no consumer evidence.
The 'Set 3' association comes from the ABI name Collision_Material_Coefficients_Set_3; no callers or callees are recorded statically (top-level or indirect-only).
